label: LoRA Lab: Detail Boosters
description: Triggerless slider LoRAs that scale rendered micro-detail. Each item's text is the quality it delivers, so it reads as prose inside a composed prompt; data carries the exact filename, the creator-stated strength and the Civitai AIR urn, so a machine missing the file can fetch it. Every item is tagged with its base-model family — a render must stay inside one family.

items.text: finely resolved micro-detail across every surface, fabric weave and material grain held crisp rather than smeared
